The **God-Warriors**, known also as the **Sunborn**, is a broad term used for the [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ascended "Universe:Ascended") that, unlike the [Baccai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Baccai "Universe:Baccai"), were accepted into the Ascended Host of [![](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/images/thumb/Shurima_Crest_icon.png/20px-Shurima_Crest_icon.png?3d027)](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). Their common form is that of anthropomorphic animals.
